intro.text: In the valley of Crumboria, every feast begins with the Great Recipe Book.
Tato, a little goose with a very big appetite, could hardly wait for the First Feast.
Then a great gust blew the book's six Flavor Pages away. Hungry creatures gobbled them up, every one!
Tato honked his bravest honk. He would eat, bounce and bop his way through six worlds and bring every page home.

page_w1.text: Mega Mushroot coughs up the Golden Crumb Page, grumbles, and toddles off for a nap.
One page home, five to go. Next stop: the Orchard, where the apples bite back.

page_w2.text: Gigantapple spits out the Amber Glaze Page. It was not very tasty anyway.
Music drifts over the hills. The Candy Carnival is in town, and so is a very greedy king.

page_w3.text: The Candy King hands over the Frosted Sugar Page, and promises to share his sweets from now on.
Brr! The trail leads across the Icy Pond. Mind your step, little goose.

page_w4.text: The Frost Puffin Lord bows and returns the Tangy Spark Page. He only wanted it for the pretty pictures.
A warm wind blows from the hills. High above the Windy Mill, something is flying off with the next page.

page_w5.text: The Sky Airship Turtle lands, yawns, and lets the Midnight Berry Page flutter down.
One page left. It is in the grandest kitchen of all: the castle, where a giant chef is cooking up trouble.

ending.text: The Chef Castle Golem sets down his spoon. He only took the pages because nobody had ever invited him to the feast.
So Tato invited him. And the Mushroot, the Apple, the King, the Puffin and the Turtle too.
With all six Flavor Pages home, the Great Recipe Book glowed, and the First Feast was the biggest Crumboria had ever seen.
And Tato? Tato had seconds. And thirds. HONK! The End.
